title: Smoky Crumble Hail Bites
description: A keto recipe for delicious, smoky bites that combine the crunch of hail with the crumbly goodness of smoky cheese.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together smoky cheese, crumbly biscuit mix, and a pinch of salt.
Crack in the egg and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Add hail and mix until evenly distributed.
Scoop out small balls of dough, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes.
